WITH rating_rentals AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rental_count
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
), rating_averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS overall_avg
  FROM rating_rentals
), above_average AS (
  SELECT rr.rental_count, ra.overall_avg
  FROM rating_rentals rr
  CROSS JOIN rating_averages ra
  WHERE rr.rental_count > ra.overall_avg
)
SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS average_figure,
       AVG(rental_count - overall_avg) AS average_amount_above_overall
FROM above_average
